column3: NASB adds “to the Chaldeans” to “goes out.”
“Courtyard of the guard” is rendered “court of the guardhouse.”
“Cushite” is rendered “Ethiopian,” and “in your hand” as “under your authority.”
“Under the storehouse” is rendered “a place beneath the storeroom.”
“Cushite” is rendered “Ethiopian,” and “joints of your hands” as “armpits.”
The Hebrew writes a word (the object marker) that is not read; NASB follows the reading.
NASB has “you will be seized” and “this city will be burned,” following some manuscripts; the Hebrew reads “you will burn this city.”
“Making fall my supplication” is rendered “presenting my petition.”
NASB omits the final clause “and it was just when Jerusalem was captured,” which it takes with 39:1.
